description.value:
A Tech sniper rifle made by the renowned Tsunami Its retrofuturistic design is a nod toward the original prototype of the series, which unfortunately never went into production. The revolutionary technology that allows you to reabsorb a portion of recoil energy and transfer it to the next shot is undoubtedly genius, but will burn a bigger hole in your pocket. Still, should you scrounge up the eddies and decide to buy, the Rasetsu will reward you with a lifetime of companionship.

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Anti-Matieral Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 3 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. This weapon may fire Improved Smart Ammunition as if it had a Smart Rebuild. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild is capable of seeing simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover.

When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6). While charged, this weapon’s Tech Rebuild halves SP but cannot penetrate Cover.

Whenever this weapon makes a successful charged Tech Rebuild Attack with Improved Smart Ammunition, it can make a second Attack without an Action as if it was ROF 2. This second attack does not expend ammunition, and can be Aimed, but must be directed at a different target within 10m/yds of the initial target.

If this weapon made a charged Tech Attack in the previous Round of combat, its Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action. While mounted to a vehicle or a similar power source, this weapon is considered to have a Silencer. This weapon Cannot be modified or fabricated by a Tech unless they have Maker Rank 7 or higher.

Range: Anti-Matieral Rifle
Pre-installed: Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
